name: training_loss
caption: Synthetic query loss against optimizer updates for the four Experiment 1 mixtures. Thin traces smooth each seed with a centered five-record moving mean; thick curves show the median across finished seeds on a shared log-spaced interpolation grid within their common observed range. Different synthetic losses do not rank credit prediction quality.

name: development_control_gap
caption: Small-context development-score differences from the seed-matched 0% credit control against optimizer updates. Curves use the same common development datasets and recorded steps; zero marks equal performance. Lines show paired seed means and shading spans plus/minus one training-seed standard deviation, not a confidence interval.
